overview.oneLineTake: Geopolitical oil shock, resurgent Fed hawkishness, and escalating trade wars are converging to end the summer rally and drive a volatility expansion regime.
themes: Oil supply shock: Brent crude surges toward $100 on direct U.S.-Iran military escalation and Hormuz Strait threats
Fed hawkish repricing: Strong August jobs data revives rate-hike bets, pushing Treasury yields toward 4.8%
North American trade war intensifies: Canadian retaliatory tariffs take effect while Trump targets Bombardier and Ford-China ties
AI sector dispersion: Infrastructure/memory chips rally on deal flow while software makers selloff on execution worries
risks: Strait of Hormuz closure or restricted zone could trigger energy price spike and global shipping freeze
Carry-trade unwind risk as yen surges to multi-month highs and Japan dumps Treasuries to fund intervention
Compressed bond volatility (6-year low post-Labor Day) may be underpricing fiscal/geopolitical tail risks
